how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-darnassus-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:730:obj:0: ⟦E1⟧ to Auberdine and look for signs of the dwarven excavation team.
rows.quest:730:details:0: How nice it is to see a ⟦1⟧ interested in the great archeological wonders of our world.
rows.quest:730:details:1: BOftentimes our work is dismissed as mere hobby by our friends in the ⟦E2⟧. But what many fail to realize is that recent discoveries in Khaz Modan have proven that a great and powerful force threatens all of ⟦E3⟧, from Lordaeron to ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:730:details:2: BI am most worried about my crew that I sent to ⟦E5⟧. They haven't sent word in weeks.
rows.quest:730:details:3: BTravel to Auberdine and look for a clue as to their whereabouts.
rows.quest:730:completion:0: I'm so glad Chief Archeologist Greywhisker sent for us....
rows.quest:952:obj:0: Deliver Fandral's message to Onu in the Grove of the Ancients in ⟦E5⟧, south of Auberdine.
rows.quest:952:details:0: If you had enough time to run messages for the Oracle Tree, then I'm sure that I can press you into service to deliver a message to the Grove of the Ancients in ⟦E5⟧, due south of Auberdine.
rows.quest:952:details:1: BYou will most likely have to secure transport on a hippogryph, but I have faith enough in you that you can manage that. Take this to Onu, the Ancient of Lore. He has been awaiting word from me, even as I waited for news from the Oracle Glade.
rows.quest:952:completion:0: Ah. Thank you, ⟦2⟧. It is strange, though. The Arch ⟦E6⟧ always seems in such a hurry. The forest knows that all shall come to pass in the appointed time. Shan'do Stormrage understood that.
rows.quest:1047:obj:0: Speak with Arch ⟦E6⟧ Fandral Staghelm at the Cenarion Enclave of ⟦E7⟧ about the Cenarion Circle's call to explore the frontiers of ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1047:details:1: BThe Cenarion Circle seeks able bodied individuals to assist them in exploring the vast new frontiers of ⟦E4⟧! A forbidden wasteland of unimaginable dangers lies far to the west of ⟦E8⟧ and Gadgetzan, and the Circle needs willing and honorable proxies to act in their stead.
rows.quest:1047:details:2: BAll interested individuals should seek audience with the Cenarion Circle. Speak with the Arch ⟦E6⟧ in ⟦E7⟧, Fandral Staghelm, for more information!
rows.quest:1047:completion:0: What makes you think I wish to be pestered by the likes of you, ⟦3⟧? Wait - let me stop the important duties I attend to on a daily basis so I can help you locate a doodad somewhere. By all means, the welfare of ⟦E7⟧ - nay, all of ⟦E9⟧ - should come second to the acquisition of a bauble for your collection.
rows.quest:1047:completion:1: BThe fools in ⟦E10⟧ waste my time with their call for assistance, and now I must endure this?
rows.quest:2518:obj:0: Priestess A'moora in the Temple of the Moon at ⟦E7⟧ wants you to bring her Lady Sathrah's Silvery Spinnerets.
rows.quest:2518:details:0: Lady Sathrah was once beloved of ⟦E11⟧. Graceful and pure, the spider spun her silver threads through the moonlight, catching the evening mist. The silvery dew had strong healing powers and was kept here in the temple.
rows.quest:2518:details:1: BBut of late, Sathrah has descended into madness. Her future generations are now threatened as well.
rows.quest:2518:details:2: BFind Lady Sathrah, ⟦4⟧, and end her suffering. She dwells along the northern borders of ⟦E9⟧, near Wellspring Lake. Gather her silvery spinnerets and bring them back to me.
rows.quest:2518:completion:0: The forest mourns for Lady Sathrah, but it was something that had to be done.
rows.quest:2519:obj:0: Sister Aquinne wants you to speak with Priestess A'moora in the Temple of the Moon.
rows.quest:2519:details:0: A once great creature of the forest is in need of help, ⟦6⟧.
rows.quest:2519:details:1: BThere is a difficult task that must be done.
rows.quest:2519:details:2: BPlease seek out Priestess A'moora; she will explain things to you. Find her to the southeast of here, inside the Temple of the Moon.
rows.quest:2520:obj:0: Priestess A'moora wants you to place Lady Sathrah's silvery spinnerets at the fountain inside the temple, and then return to her.
rows.quest:2520:details:0: Now you must finish the task to which you have been appointed. Take the spinnerets and offer Lady Sathrah's sacrifice to ⟦E11⟧; lay the great spider to rest.
rows.quest:2520:details:1: BInside this temple, find the central fountain. There is where you may leave the sacrifice. The holy waters will purify and cleanse the corruption that drove Sathrah mad.
rows.quest:2520:details:2: BWhen you have completed this, return to me.
rows.quest:2520:completion:0: The loss of Lady Sathrah is distressing, but in this way only may she be reborn with a renewed spirit.
rows.quest:2520:completion:1: BMay ⟦E11⟧ willingly accept the sacrifice that you have offered her.
rows.quest:3763:obj:0: Speak with Arch ⟦E6⟧ Fandral Staghelm in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:3763:details:0: Excuse me ⟦7⟧, but I'd like just a moment of your time if possible.
rows.quest:3763:details:1: BThe Cenarion Circle in ⟦E7⟧ is looking for seasoned adventurers such as yourself to lend them aid in a vital research project. While I do not know the specifics, I can inform you that none other than Arch ⟦E6⟧ Fandral Staghelm is spearheading this research.
rows.quest:3763:details:2: BPlease - if you are interested, speak with him directly in the Cenarion Enclave within ⟦E7⟧ proper.
rows.quest:3763:completion:0: Well now, ⟦8⟧... since you were informed that I was leading this research myself, you obviously came as quickly as you could.
rows.quest:3763:completion:1: BNow that you are here, be sure to pay attention the first time I tell you the details; I have no desire to repeat myself.
rows.quest:3764:obj:0: Bring 20 Un'Goro Soil samples to Jenal at the Cenarion Enclave in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:3764:details:0: The soil of ⟦E12⟧ is reportedly enriched with potent magical qualities. I want to know facts from falsehoods; go into the wilds of Un'Goro and acquire enough quality samples of soil for our continued study.
rows.quest:3764:details:1: BYou may think that collection tasks are beneath you; that sort of attitude does not endear yourself to me or the Cenarion Circle. Bring the samples to Jenal, who is no doubt wasting time outside behind this tree; just look for the piles of dirt. He will handle the logistics - not I.
rows.quest:3764:completion:0: Unload your precious cargo here, noble ⟦9⟧. It must have been quite the burden... not unlike the burden I carry being a visionary. Here is an honorarium for your work, as dictated by the Arch ⟦E6⟧ himself.
rows.quest:3764:completion:1: BArch ⟦E6⟧ Staghelm wants to speak with you again ⟦10⟧, but for his next task you will be aided if you have a journeyman's understanding of ⟦E13⟧. If you don't know it though, you will still be able to aid the Circle!
rows.quest:3781:obj:0: Take the Arch ⟦E6⟧'s Seed Voucher to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave of ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:3781:details:0: With what we call an Evergreen Pouch, we have cultivated Tharlendris seeds in the soil from ⟦E12⟧. These seeds blossom into an array of random, potent herbs. One result is morrowgrain, a mysterious herb we know little about; I intend to unravel this mystery.
rows.quest:3781:details:1: BTake this to Mathrengyl downstairs, and he will give you some seeds so you can get started. If you run out, you will need to purchase more from him.
rows.quest:3781:completion:0: Yes, this voucher is good for twenty packets of seeds. If you run out, we have more that can be provided. Unfortunately though, Tharlendris seeds are quite costly to produce in significant numbers. This is why the Cenarion Circle asks that those who are assisting us help out by offsetting some of the cost.
rows.quest:3781:completion:1: BThose who return with morrowgrain find that the reward the Arch ⟦E6⟧ offers far makes up for the cost.
rows.quest:3785:obj:0: Use an Evergreen Pouch with a Packet of Tharlendis Seeds and two Un'Goro Soil samples to try and cultivate samples of Morrowgrain.
rows.quest:3785:obj:1: BBring 10 Morrowgrain to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:3785:details:0: Here's your Evergreen Pouch that you'll need to use the Tharlendis seeds with. You also need to have Un'Goro soil samples on hand to use as fertilizer for the seeds. Just use the pouch when you have everything; the pouch will take care of the rest.
rows.quest:3785:details:1: BWhen you have enough morrowgrain, bring them here to me in the enclave. Please don't bother the Arch ⟦E6⟧; he's a very busy man, and he doesn't need to be disturbed every time someone returns with another batch of morrowgrain!
rows.quest:3785:completion:0: Well done ⟦11⟧, I will be sure to give these to the Arch ⟦E6⟧ himself when he has need of them. Meanwhile, please accept this as a token of the Cenarion Circle's appreciation.
rows.quest:3785:completion:1: BOur need for morrowgrain, for now, is constant; if you wish to continue aiding us, then please return when you have cultivated more of it.
rows.quest:4493:obj:0: Speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:4493:details:0: It would seem that the silithid's intent, nay - reason for being, is to devour everything in their path that is not of their ecology. Their focus is singular, and it is for this reason they are a grave threat to all life on ⟦E3⟧.
rows.quest:4493:details:1: BWhat we've seen to date is but the first stages. I suspect that their strength comes from deeper in ⟦E4⟧: ⟦E12⟧. Go to Gadgetzan in the ⟦E8⟧ desert and speak to Alchemist Pestlezugg. Tell him of my theory; he will surely aid us in fighting the silithid.
rows.quest:4493:completion:0: Yes, I gathered that Gracina sent you to me. Your experience in fighting these beasties is priceless; no one to my knowledge has ever dealt with their kind before. As for Gracina's idea that ⟦E12⟧ is their heart... perhaps it is. Un'Goro is a mysterious and dangerous jungle to the west of here. Perhaps it is also one step closer to figuring out what the silithid are all about.
rows.quest:4510:obj:0: Bring the Bank Voucher to Idriana in the bank of ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:4510:details:0: ⟦12⟧, your help has been immeasurable. The time will come, no doubt, when I'll ask for your assistance against the silithid once more. We must absorb what we have learned in Un'Goro; I fear that my assumptions that the silithid originated from Un'Goro are now wrong... that indeed there is a far stronger presence somewhere.
rows.quest:4510:details:1: BTake this note to Idriana at the bank. She'll give you something from my vault that should be viewed as a token of my gratitude. Thank you for your assistance, brave ⟦13⟧.
rows.quest:4510:completion:0: This bank voucher authorizes me to withdraw an item from Gracina Spiritmight's account with us and present it to you. Congratulations would seem to be in order!
rows.quest:5091:obj:0: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist. His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the ⟦E14⟧.
rows.quest:5091:details:0: Hear ye, hear ye! All heroes are called upon to heed these words!
rows.quest:5091:details:1: BA call to arms has been issued by the Kingdom of ⟦E15⟧! All able bodied individuals are entreated to take up arms against the dark threat of the Scourge in the northern lands of the ⟦E16⟧! Rumors fly of new threats rising from the ruins of the ⟦E17⟧!
rows.quest:5091:details:2: BHeroes of the realm - seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist who has set up his base camp in Chillwind Camp, north of the ⟦E14⟧!
rows.quest:5091:completion:0: Welcome to the ⟦E17⟧, hero. This is one of the most dangerous frontiers in ⟦E3⟧, especially with the looming threat of the Scourge to our north and northeast. I am glad to hear that the clarion call of duty and service to the greater good did not fall on deaf ears with you!
rows.quest:5091:completion:1: BIf you are ready to get your hands dirty, then there is plenty for willing and able heroes to do here on the edge of the ⟦E17⟧.
rows.quest:6344:details:0: A friend of mine, Nessa Shadowsong, is a fishing merchant in Rut'theran Village. She needs a parcel taken to ⟦E5⟧, and is looking for someone to help her.
rows.quest:6344:details:1: BIf you're interested, then to reach Nessa you must take the portal in ⟦E7⟧ to Rut'theran Village. You will find the portal west of the Temple Gardens.
rows.quest:6344:completion:0: Yes, I have need of a courier who will take a package to ⟦E5⟧. Will you help me?
rows.quest:6761:obj:0: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker at the Cenarion Enclave of ⟦E7⟧.
rows.quest:6761:details:0: I have relegated my second, Mathrengyl Bearwalker, to deal with ⟦E10⟧'s call for aid. Speak to him on this matter - NOT me.
rows.quest:6761:details:1: BLet me give you some... friendly... advice. It is I who led us out of the darkness - NOT the Cenarion Circle in ⟦E10⟧ - when all was lost for our race. ⟦E9⟧ gives us all new life! They would have you believe otherwise, and to believe their propaganda would be a fool's task.
rows.quest:6761:details:2: BI'll leave it to you to decide whether or not you're a fool.
rows.quest:6761:completion:0: Yes ⟦14⟧, thank you for coming. I apologize about the misunderstanding... the air is thick with mistrust between the Arch ⟦E6⟧ here and Keeper Remulos in ⟦E10⟧. Each suspect the other of chicanery, and the fact that strange corruptions of ⟦E9⟧ continue unabated are still an issue here. It does little to quell mistrust.
rows.quest:6761:completion:1: BRegardless, our duty to the Cenarion Circle remains... even if those who lead it may disagree with one another.
rows.quest:6762:obj:0: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, ⟦E10⟧. ⟦E10⟧ lies between ⟦E18⟧ and ⟦E19⟧, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.
rows.quest:6762:details:0: For this task, Keeper Remulos' majordomo in ⟦E10⟧ - Rabine Saturna - seeks aid in exploring the vast wastelands far to the west of ⟦E8⟧... and even further west of Un'Goro. You should find him in Nighthaven, the main village of ⟦E10⟧.
rows.quest:6762:details:1: BWhile your work will no doubt be of tremendous benefit to us all, I advise you to tread gingerly. There are tensions between ⟦E7⟧ and ⟦E10⟧... ones that may grow over the course of time.
rows.quest:6762:completion:0: I am Rabine Saturna, and on behalf of Keeper Remulos and all of the denizens of this sacred glade I bid you welcome.
rows.quest:6762:completion:1: BI appreciate your interest and eagerness to assist the Cenarion Circle. I also know that Arch ⟦E6⟧ of ⟦E7⟧ expressed his displeasure to you in your lending us aid. Rest assured that it is for the greater good, and that you will be safe from any ill-conceived repercussions you may be the target of.
rows.quest:7792:completion:0: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, ⟦16⟧!
rows.quest:7798:completion:0: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, ⟦17⟧!
rows.quest:7799:completion:0: Wonderful! We thank you for your generous donation, ⟦18⟧!
rows.quest:7800:completion:0: Fantastic - these will go right to use, I assure you. Thank you again for your assistance! We'd certainly be lost without you.
rows.quest:7800:completion:1: BWith all the donations you've made, I would certainly process any additional runecloth donations you care to make in the future. Just be sure to check in with me, and I'll personally make sure that your good deeds won't go unrecognized!
